domain: Software Engineering & Data Architecture — COD E-commerce (Pancake POS + BigQuery)

checklist: Performance: No N+1 queries in loops?
Testing: Critical paths covered by unit tests?
Error Handling: Try/Except blocks specific (no bare 'except:')?
BigQuery SQL: Uses PARTITION BY for date filters?
BigQuery SQL: Uses CLUSTER BY for high-cardinality columns?
BigQuery SQL: Avoids SELECT * (specify columns to reduce scan cost)?
BigQuery SQL: ROW_NUMBER() for dedup on incremental loads?
Pancake API: Monetary fields divided by 100 (bani conversion)?
Pancake API: Status 7 (deleted) excluded from all queries?
Pancake API: marketer field uses JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR, not string parse?
n8n Workflow: Error handling node present on all HTTP requests?
n8n Workflow: Dedup logic before BigQuery INSERT (avoid duplicates)?
Agent Script: knowledge.json path resolved via Path(__file__).parent.parent?

severity_levels.blocker: Security flaw, data corruption, or financial miscalculation
severity_levels.critical: Wrong revenue/profit number, missing status filter, N+1 query
severity_levels.major: Maintainability issue, missing error handling, spaghetti code

bigquery_anti_patterns: SELECT * on partitioned tables (scans all data = expensive)
Using INT64 for Pancake IDs (they can change format, use STRING)
Not deduplicating incremental loads (creates phantom revenue)
Storing monetary fields as INT64 before ÷100 (precision loss)

structure: Context: What is the problem in our COD ecommerce system?
Options Considered: What alternatives were evaluated?
Decision: What are we doing and why?
Consequences: Impact on BigQuery cost, n8n workflows, agent accuracy
Review Date: When to revisit this decision?

example_decisions.title: Use BigQuery Views instead of Materialized Tables for P&L
example_decisions.context: Storage cost vs query speed trade-off
example_decisions.decision: Views for daily reports (<1s), Materialized for monthly aggregation
example_decisions.consequence: $0 storage cost for daily views, ~$5/TB scan cost

example_decisions.title: LangGraph for Agent Orchestration instead of pure n8n
example_decisions.context: n8n cannot handle cyclic debate loops between agents
example_decisions.decision: LangGraph for brain (thinking), n8n for muscle (execution)
example_decisions.consequence: Need Python server hosting, but gain stateful multi-turn conversations

database: No transactional DB needed (Pancake is source)
forbidden_patterns: Global mutable state in agent scripts
Using partner.cod as revenue (it's carrier-collected, not order amount)

knowledge_json_rules: All formulas must reference actual BigQuery field names
Must be valid JSON (no trailing commas)
script_rules: Must set stdout encoding to utf-8
